5. FALSE PREMISE: Premises: trial not randomised (true), control arm includes patients assigned by clinician judgement (true), severity is baseline severity (true), responded is 1 if endpoint met at week 12 (true). No false premise.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, no issues.
